typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		COL_XML as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	procedureName: '[Pr_GenerateXML_TC_LETTER]',
	schemaName: '[Invoice]',
	resultSet: true,
	format: 'procedure',
	staged:false) ~> LetterSrc	source(output(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT [TOTALRECCOUNT] FROM INVOICE.TC_LetterTrailer AS TRAILER WHERE BatchId = ?',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
LetterSrc derive({Copy of COL_XML} = toString(COL_XML)) ~> Letterconversion
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		TOTALRECCOUNT as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		TOTALRECCOUNT)) ~> FlatFileDestination
Letterconversion sink(input(
		Copy_of_COL_XML as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Copy_of_COL_XML = {Copy of COL_XML})) ~> XMLDestination
